description.value: Burnt Orange Cafe + Bistro is a brunch and lunch spot on Hastings Street in Burnaby, known for its specialty fluffy pancakes and 49th Parallel coffee. It operates seven days a week and offers table reservations, suggesting a sit-down dining experience. A touring cyclist rolling along the Hastings corridor would find it a solid mid-morning or midday refuelling stop.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 86m; stands (8 spaces) at 88m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 12 spaces.
